I’m really counting on this being taken care of today—please go ahead and waive the fee. If that’s not possible, I need to know why.We’re sorry, but we’re unable to waive the late fee at this time. 

We understand this is frustrating. As a next step, we can offer you a payment plan or a one‑time courtesy credit of $5 to help offset the fee. Please let us know which option you’d prefer.I understand, but I really can’t afford the extra charge. Could you at least apply the $5 credit? That would help a lot.Sure, I’ve applied a $5 courtesy credit to your account. This will be reflected on your next statement. Is there anything else I can help you with today?No, that’s everything. Thank you for your help. ###STOP###
